sn22.155:1.2: Kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave sati kim upādāya kim abhinivissa sakkāyadiṭṭhi uppajjatīti || || 4
sn22.155:1.4: Rūpe kho bhikkhave sati rūpam upādāya rūpam abhinivissa sakkāyadiṭṭhi uppajjati || || 6-9
sn22.155:1.8: Viññāṇe sati viññāṇam upādāya viññāṇam abhinivissa sakkāyadiṭṭhi uppajjati || || 10
sn22.155:1.13: api nu tam anupādāya sakkāya diṭṭhi uppajjeyyā ti || ||
sn22.155:1.18: Viññāṇam niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || ||
sn22.155:1.21: api nu tam anupādāya sakkāyadiṭṭhi uppajjeyyāti || ||
